lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste, this is a cyber awareness message from Hyderabad city police.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Fraudsters are calling people pretending to be CBI or customs officers and claiming a digital arrest. There is no such thing as digital arrest.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Police will never ask you to transfer money to a safe account or to install AnyDesk.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you get such a call, hang up and report it on 1930. Please share this with your family.
